title: GateRun
description: MCP gate_status: the async plan-review / completion run handle for a review_plan_start or verify_completion_start job. `status` is running, then passed or failed; attaching awaits a duplicate's index record, and unknown marks an unrecognized job id (which carries no ticket_id, gate_type, or findings). A settled run adds verdict, error, durable (signed-certificate currency), and findings (plan-review sidecar readability).
